summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Plan for ARCA-61 — Saved watchlists not persisting across login  **No code has been touched.** I did a read-only trace of the entire path (client → API → DB) to make the plan concrete instead of speculative. Summary of what I found, then what I'd actually do, then the risks.  ### What I already verified (read-only) - `client/src/App.tsx`: `WatchlistPage` only renders once `useAuth()` resolves a real `user` — unauthenticated visitors get bounced to `LoginPage`, so there's no anonymous render of the watchlist page. - `WatchlistPage.tsx`: fetches/saves everything via `api.get/post/dele
